'''Zon Zorad''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Arda II]], who was the son of ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Kiros Zorad]] and worked for [[Mag Doum]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Zon and his father were ordered by [[Mag Doum]] to kidnap Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from uncovering a mystery how T6 Diodems were been sold to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Zon and Kiros were so indebted by Doum and had no choice but to follow his command. After Kiros had dropped Zon and Leia off at the [[Caverns of Colla-Di]], he then led Luke to the [[Great Torgur Falls]] away from the Catacombs. However, Zon and Leia were attacked by the [[Kdak]]. Zon immediately saved Leia's life from the Kdak, but was injured in the process, and now Leia was helping the son of Kiros to the road. When Doum fled from [[Arda II]] and contacts [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Zon's father was able to push aside Mag and send a message to Arda II and warned everyone of Vader's impending attack. Zon was among those that joined the Rebel Alliance and volunteered to fly an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. During the [[Attack on Arda II|battle]], Zon tried to contact his father who sacrificing his life to a collision course with the bridge of the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Distracted, he is quickly shot down by a couple of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].
